title: Merge the Play Store fixes into main
detail: Builds Swap V 1.2 as an APK. Testers get an "update available" notice.

title: Test V 1.2 on your phone
detail: Sign up, accept the 18+ screen, list an item, swap with a second account, report someone, then delete a test account.

title: Turn on GitHub Pages
detail: Repo Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch main, folder /docs. Publishes the privacy, terms and delete-account pages.

title: Add a contact email
detail: Put the address people can write to in docs/site.js. Google Play needs a working contact.

title: Set Supabase sign-in settings
detail: Site URL and redirect URLs to the GitHub Pages address, and a minimum password length of 8.

title: Make yourself an admin
detail: Supabase Table Editor → admin_users → add your user id. Unlocks the Reports screen.

title: Create an upload key
detail: Generate it once with keytool and add the four UPLOAD_* secrets to the repo.

title: Register a Google Play developer account
detail: Play Console sign-up and identity check.

title: Build the Play bundle and start a closed test
detail: Run "Build for Google Play (AAB)". New personal accounts need 12 testers for 14 days before production.

title: Fill in the store listing and Data safety form
detail: Screenshots, description, content rating, target audience 18+, and the privacy policy link.

title: Release to production
detail: Submit for review and roll out Swap on Google Play.
